divergence: Mixed (T1, T2 pass; T0 fails). All three runs surfaced the defence matter in their first path search and kept the same four other candidates. They split at the first screening stage: T1 and T2 included the defence matter's assessment in their first batch of reads, while T0 read only its four-matter shortlist and never opened it. The reviews differed before that point: T1's path-search review named the defence matter as wrongly dismissed and T2's own summary listed it as a possible candidate, while T0's reviews only flagged dozens of unopened matters, with this one buried in the harness's long unopened-matter note. Label notes and new stages played no role in the split; T2's five declared new stages were all scan steps and a file-name index.
